# Ahmad Yar Automation Tools

Canonical site: https://ahmadyar.co/tools

## Automation Architecture Advisor

Canonical URL: https://ahmadyar.co/tools/automation-architecture-advisor

A free interactive advisor for choosing an automation architecture and platform mix based on the systems a business already uses, current and future workflow count, execution volume, workflow complexity, APIs, branching, AI, databases, durable jobs, reliability consequences, ownership, governance, hosting requirements, budget, and growth.

The advisor can recommend native automation in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, Shopify, or Microsoft environments; integration platforms such as Zapier or Make; orchestration platforms such as n8n, Pipedream, Activepieces, Workato, Tray.ai, or MuleSoft; Trigger.dev for developer-owned durable background jobs; and custom software for product-like or transactional logic.

The recommendation engine is deterministic and does not require an AI API. It can recommend different tools for different workflow classes rather than forcing an entire company onto one platform.

The page also includes a decision framework, platform trade-offs, architecture examples, methodology, and frequently asked questions intended to help people compare automation approaches even without completing the interactive assessment.
